record.what_it_does: Cloud accounting software for small businesses: invoicing, bills, payments, bookkeeping.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow, with apps registered in the Intuit Developer Portal. Sandbox accepts localhost redirect URIs. Production needs a public HTTPS callback. Access tokens are short-lived, and refresh tokens rotate and must be persisted. No personal access token or API-key option was found. The OAuth docs pages on developer.intuit.com render client-side and returned no content, so the auth details are confirmed through Intuit's own MCP README.
record.access_notes: A free developer account gives development keys and sandbox companies. Production keys need a successful app assessment questionnaire, completed per app; Intuit blocks production keys if requirements aren't met. App Partner Program: every partner starts in the free Builder tier. Core (data-in) calls are free and unlimited. CorePlus (data-out/read) calls are capped at 500,000 per month on Builder, and calls over the cap error out. Silver, Gold and Platinum tiers carry fees and need a payment method. Publishing to the App Store needs a separate review.
record.api_breadth_notes: The QuickBooks Online Accounting API (REST/JSON v3) covers about 40 entities, including Customer, Vendor, Invoice, Bill, Payment, Account, Item, JournalEntry, Estimate, PurchaseOrder, Attachable and Reports. Each supports create, read, update, delete and query operations, plus a SQL-like query endpoint and batch. Intuit's MCP server exposes 145 tools over this API, which supports roughly 100+ operations. Payments, Payroll and some GraphQL (Premium APIs) are separate. The exact count wasn't confirmed from Intuit's API Explorer, which renders client-side.
record.mcp_notes: Hosted: https://ai-inc.quickbooks.intuit.com/v1/mcp, on Intuit's domain, using Streamable HTTP and OAuth through Intuit sign-in. Directories credit it to QuickBooks, and it is reportedly listed in Claude's directory as 'Made by Intuit QuickBooks'. Local: github.com/intuit/quickbooks-online-mcp-server, MIT licence, stdio, 145 tools. Many third-party hosted servers also exist.
record.blocker_notes: Development and sandbox work is self-serve. Connecting real companies needs production keys gated by the per-app assessment questionnaire, plus terms, company address and other setup. Read-heavy agent usage may exceed the free Builder cap of 500k CorePlus calls per month, which needs a paid tier.
